summary: Tested NEW 'Resolve Missing Values' deep-backfill feature (backend + frontend) and the two just-fixed regressions: job-status-masking and sticky-valuation-fallback. All verified working correctly. Deep backfill target count is currently 0 (all items already resolved during main agent's dev testing), so backend consistently returns {total:0, resolved:0, still_missing:0} and status='done'. Confirmed via backend logs that the OLD bug (job incorrectly marked 'failed' when the internal follow-up refresh_inventory_cache() call failed) is fixed: an old log entry from BEFORE the fix (13:11:14, pre-reload) showed 'Deep UUID backfill failed' due to an unrelated inventory-OData timeout - exactly the masking bug described. After the fix (post-reload), ran the job twice via curl and twice via Playwright UI - all 4 runs completed with status='done' and a valid result object even though the follow-up refresh step is known to hit SAP timeouts (confirmed timeouts logged as INFO-level 'Standard Costs unavailable...' warnings only, never surfaced as job failure). Sticky-valuation fix verified: GET /api/inventory currently shows 1727 items with non-null/non-zero total_value out of 3177 total (>1000 as required, consistent with baseline ~1754/1727 - not wiped to 0 despite live Standard Costs API repeatedly timing out during testing). Frontend Dialog UI (open/running-progress-bar/done-result/close-button-disabled-while-running) all verified via Playwright end-to-end, including the 'Last Updated' badge auto-refreshing after backfill completes. Smoke-tested BOM Explorer (route '/') and Purchasing Plan (route '/purchasing-plan') pages - both load and render correctly, no regressions from inventory_service.py/server.py changes.

minor.issue: The follow-up cache-refresh step (auto-triggered after backfill) can take 2-4+ minutes when the SAP tenant is slow/timing out, during which the job stays 'running' with progress stuck at 0/0 (since the backfill itself, having 0 targets, finishes instantly but the job isn't marked 'done' until the follow-up refresh also finishes/fails). This matches expected tenant behavior per the review request and is NOT a bug, but worth noting UX-wise: users may think the backfill itself is slow when it's actually the unrelated follow-up refresh.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py run() closure correctly separates the backfill result (reported as job's real status/result) from the best-effort follow-up refresh_inventory_cache() call (wrapped in its own try/except with only a warning log on failure) - exactly matches the described fix for the status-masking bug. Verified via logs: pre-fix code (before a server.py reload observed mid-session) logged 'Deep UUID backfill failed' due to an inventory-OData timeout that should have been unrelated to the backfill itself; post-fix, no such masking observed across 4 test runs.

inventory_service.py build_inventory() sticky-valuation fallback (lines ~135-153) correctly reads get_cached_inventory(db)['items'] BEFORE overwriting the cache, and falls back per-item to previously cached unit_cost/total_value when the fresh Standard Costs lookup returns no price for that item - verified via live GET /api/inventory showing 1727 non-null/non-zero total_value items sustained across multiple refresh cycles despite repeated live SAP Standard Costs timeouts in backend logs during this test session.

_get_deep_backfill_targets(db) correctly excludes items with an existing product_uuid AND items already present in bom_node_cache (checked-before, even if unresolved) - clean zero-extra-SAP-call design as described.
No code changes made during this test session; all functionality verified as-is.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing live inventory_cache (3177 items) and bom_node_cache state
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deep Backfill feature (button, dialog, progress, result, close-button-disabled-while-running) and both regression fixes (job-status-masking, sticky-valuation-fallback) are fully verified working via both backend curl polling and Playwright UI end-to-end runs. Deep-backfill target count is currently 0 (everything already resolved) so resolved/still_missing counts are trivially 0 in this session - if main agent wants to test with a non-zero target count, would need to manually clear a product_uuid + remove its bom_node_cache entry for a test item first. BOM Explorer and Purchasing Plan smoke-tested only (page load), no deep functional retest per review request (low risk, no code changes to those paths).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no unresolved bugs found in this session's changes. The two previously-reported bugs (job-status-masking, sticky-valuation zeroing) both show clear before/after evidence in backend logs confirming the fixes are effective.
